data_quality_findings: Main log: 427 records, 90 base columns used; rows carry 91-151 tab fields; 0 rows exceed the 271-column header; rows parsed by position, neighbour fields not analysed.

Timestamps: 427/427 match YYYY.MM.DD_HH.MM.SS, non-decreasing=True, 353 distinct seconds; 143 records share a second with another record; sampling is irregular (median interval 1 s, max 93 s, 43 intervals > 10 s covering 1367 s = 72.1% of the duration).

Units/ranges: valid values lie inside plausible reporting ranges - NR SS-RSRP -121..-68 dBm, SS-RSRQ -18..-7 dB, SS-SINR -7..19 dB; LTE RSRP -121..-63 dBm, RSRQ -20..-7 dB, SINR -19..25 dB; no Level=-201 code; non-numeric values other than "-"/empty: 0.
Missing values: NR SS-SINR "-" in 7 of 221 5G-labelled records; LTE anchor fields empty in 1 5G-labelled record(s); no other KPI value missing.

Suspected label-transition artefacts kept in the main statistics (schema-literal): 7 5G-labelled records whose Level/Qual duplicate LTE values (NR SINR missing) and 12 4G-labelled records whose Level/Qual duplicate the next NR values; excluding them changes the NR SS-RSRP mean from -99.068 to -99.439 dBm and the LTE RSRP mean from -92.845 to -92.749 dBm.

No NR identifiers are logged: ARFCN (1600, 2950, 6350) and BAND (L20, L3, L7) are LTE values in all records, also in 5G-labelled ones, where Node/CellID/PSC/ARFCN/BAND equal the SecondCell (anchor) fields in 220 of 220 records with anchor data; NR band is unknown for all 221 5G-labelled records.
NRSTATE, CSI_RSRP, CSI_RSRQ and CSI_SNR are empty in all 427 records; NetworkTypeNum=13 in all records; SA cannot be inferred and the 5G label is treated as NSA only because the schema note says so.

No active test was run: Test_Status, PINGAVG/MIN/MAX, TESTDOWNLINK and TESTUPLINK are empty in all records, so throughput and RTT are N/A; DL_bitrate/UL_bitrate (non-zero in 114/112 records) are passive traffic counters.

GPS: coordinates numeric and in range in 427/427 records, Accuracy <= 23 m; 64 records repeat an identical fix for >= 10 s (11 frozen runs, 1247 s) and are excluded from spatial outputs only; 6 of these runs end with a jump faster than the maximum logged Speed (71 km/h), i.e. the position was stale.
Speed unit check: on 228 well-sampled steps GPS-derived speed is 45.8 km/h against 49.9 km/h logged, consistent with km/h.
Operator code is 22610 in 224 records and 22601 in 203 records although Operatorname is "orange" in every record.

Readings are refreshed more slowly than records are written: 44.1% of consecutive 5G-labelled record pairs and 37.0% of consecutive 4G-labelled pairs repeat the identical Level/Qual/SNR triplet, so samples are not independent.
LTERSSI is not consistent with RSRP: RSRP >= LTERSSI in 135 of 206 4G-labelled records (65.5%); LTERSSI is not used in any statistic.

Events file: 79 events, identical to the EVENT/EVENTDETAILS column of the main log=True; every source and target ARFCN is an LTE EARFCN, so IRAT/5G event names reflect the application label, not NR cell changes; 2 events change only the PCI of an unchanged node-cell.

Sampling is uneven: 254 records (59.5%) were written in the first 271 s (14.3% of the duration) before the application went to background at 12.20.49; afterwards 60 of 152 background records coincide with a cell-change event, so sample statistics over-represent the first part of the route and cell-change instants.
Altitude equals Height in 427/427 records; BATTERY constant (41); TA empty in 98 records; IMEI/IMSI/MSISDN/Cellname empty.
